title: Junior ने resume के पैसे दिए, और वो तुम्हारी पहली कमाई थी
experiment: none: a bet slot, the first money reel of channel test T4 (Earn with AI), and a sequel to the #11 hit (resumes, ATS).
look: illustrated story, my face and body (hoodie), Ananya as the junior, Rohan at the chai stall, a drawn laptop with a resume, compact captions
sendTo: वो दोस्त जिसे pocket money चाहिए
style: Natural conversational Hindi as spoken in India, like a friend who tells you a short story and lets you in on a useful find. English words in Indian English. Confident, clear and brisk, one even tone for the whole story, with only a short breath between sentences. No acting, no exaggeration.
sources: https://gemini.google/discover/ai-career-coach/ (captured 2026-10-21, India): 'Bye-bye, blank page syndrome. Stop starting from scratch. With Canvas, Gemini acts as your AI CV builder ... creating professional CV templates ...'; picture text: 'Draft a one-page, ATS-friendly résumé for my job application at...'.

https://www.canva.com/resumes/templates/ (captured 2026-10-21, India): 'Resume templates. Land your dream job with captivating CVs you can customize to reflect your true potential. Explore Canva's free resume templates and create a polished resume in minutes.'
https://gemini.google/subscriptions/ (captured 2026-10-21 for #16, India): 'Free of charge ... ₹0 INR/month with a Google Account'.
https://www.fiverr.com/categories/writing-translation/resume-writing showed a bot check to the capture, so no platform and no price is shown.
claims: Gemini can draft a resume: the career coach page ('AI CV builder'; the ATS-friendly résumé prompt).
Canva has free resume templates: its page says so (some templates on Canva are Pro; the voice says 'a free template').
Money: no amount anywhere, on screen or in the voice; the payment is a drawn hand-over. The honest catch is said aloud: work comes slowly at first, and every resume has to be checked with care.
Story, not data: Ananya, the batch group and the chai.

sentences: Junior ने resume के पैसे दिए, और वो तुम्हारी पहली कमाई थी।
और आधा काम AI ने किया।
Ananya को internship के लिए resume चाहिए था।
तुमने Gemini में उसकी details डालीं और लिखा, एक page का ATS-friendly resume बनाओ।
फिर Canva का एक free template चुना और text उसमें डाल दिया।
Ananya ने उसे देखा, और पैसे ख़ुद आगे कर दिए।
ऐसे और AI कमाई के तरीकों के लिए follow कर लो।
Ananya ने तुम्हारा नाम अपने पूरे batch के group में भेज दिया।
हाँ, शुरू में काम धीरे आता है, और हर resume ध्यान से check करना पड़ता है।
पर उस पहली कमाई से तुमने सबको chai पिलाई।
Comment में कुछ भी लिख दो।
उस दोस्त को भेजो जिसे pocket money चाहिए।
